data.body: Gate notes. inv rebar-review-plan grounds on origin/main (b7360c8), which predates ADEVX-131, and blocked ADEVX-148 on commit-tree being absent there until rerun with --gate-ref origin/v0.3.1. inv rebar-review-code returns an inert PASS while verify.enable_code_review is false, and REBAR_VERIFY_ENABLE_CODE_REVIEW=true enables it per run. inv ci from a worktree imports the main checkout through the editable install unless PYTHONPATH names the worktree. test_region_and_profile_defaults_are_fedramp_aligned fails on v0.3.1 whenever the shell exports AWS_PROFILE.
